observed.pricing_architecture: ElevenAgents charges agent-call usage on applicable subscriptions. Voice calls are duration-based, text-only calls are per message, and LLM charges are passed through separately; higher subscriptions include voice minutes and lower incremental rates.

plans.name: Subscription-backed usage
plans.price_note: Applicable subscription plans include varying voice-minute allowances and incremental rates.

free_access.note: This product record captures agent usage layered on subscriptions; eligibility and included capacity vary by plan.

expansion_vectors.description: Voice agent calls scale with duration.
Text-only calls are priced per message.

analysis.monetization_summary: ElevenAgents layers channel-specific usage and external model pass-through on top of the vendor's subscription structure.
